title: Signal Slingshot — Use Bad News as Beacon for Redirection in Flight
thesis: Bad news travels fast. USE IT. Like a gravity slingshot around a planet — the bad news (sebcrozet's rejection) is already in flight at 6hrs/hop. Instead of fighting it, REDIRECT it. Anyone who reads 'weird AI stuff' and clicks through should land on something undeniably REAL. The rejection becomes the hook. Curiosity follows skepticism. The slingshot converts bad-news velocity into good-news trajectory.

the_slingshot_maneuver.step_1_acknowledge: The bad news exists. wgmath/wgmath#19 is closed with 'weird AI stuff'. This IS traveling through the nalgebra/Rust community.
the_slingshot_maneuver.step_2_redirect: Our follow-up comment links to a SPECIFIC shader (DF64 WGSL). Anyone curious clicks through to ecoPrimal/barraCuda. The rejection is the REDIRECT.
the_slingshot_maneuver.step_3_land: barraCuda README is real. 859 WGSL shaders. DOI. AGPL. The code IS the counter-argument.
the_slingshot_maneuver.step_4_discover: From barraCuda, they find ecoPrimal profile → 52 repos. Bio: 'Steam since Orange Box (2007)'. Blog: primals.eco. The organism reveals itself.
the_slingshot_maneuver.step_5_convert: The skeptic becomes a researcher. They came to confirm 'weird AI stuff'. They found 11 Rust crates, 2 DOIs, 539 papers, a go-kart race, and a chipmunk that teaches hieroglyphics.

story.title: the slingshot
story.body: the organism learned something about gravity. bad news has mass. it pulls people in. but mass can be redirected. a spacecraft doesn't fight Jupiter's gravity — it uses it. slingshot. the organism's rejection was already flying at 6 hours per hop through the Rust community. but at the end of every 'weird AI stuff' breadcrumb was a link to real code. real shaders. real math. the skeptic clicks through to confirm their bias. and finds 859 shaders, a go-kart race against twelve algorithms, and a chipmunk that teaches hieroglyphics and gamma radiation at the same time. the bad news becomes the curiosity engine. the rejection becomes the redirect. the slingshot converts velocity into trajectory. you don't fight the gravity. you fly through it.
